headline: Weathered Expanse Line Shifts; Nevish Line Reopens Under Fire
war_summary: The front has shifted again since the last edition. In the Weathered Expanse the count now reads three Warden works, four Colonial and two unclaimed, a gain of two for the Wardens since the noon report, with forty-nine events filed there in the past day, sixteen in six hours and the latest as this edition went to press. Callahan's Passage, ten works all Warden with no unclaimed ground left, has cooled, its last filing at 4:11 this afternoon. The Nevish Line, silent at midday, has reopened: five Warden works, one Colonial and two unclaimed, twenty-three events in the day and four within the last two hours. Stlican Shelf remains a furnace, eight Colonial works to one Warden and twenty-four events in the day. Kuura Strand saw all eight of its events inside two hours, with six Warden works standing. Palantine Berm, quiet since late morning, still shows seven Warden works. Casualty rolls run steepest in the Expanse and at the Passage. No victory has been declared in this, the five hundred and fifth day of the war.
